description: Multi-vendor marketplace schema with buyers, sellers, inventory, orders, and shipments.
sql: CREATE TABLE sellers (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100)); CREATE TABLE items (id INT PRIMARY KEY, seller_id INT REFERENCES sellers(id), price DECIMAL(10,2));

description: Hospital patient management, appointments, doctors, and medical records.
sql: CREATE TABLE patients (id INT PRIMARY KEY, full_name VARCHAR(120), dob DATE); CREATE TABLE doctors (id INT PRIMARY KEY, full_name VARCHAR(120), specialty VARCHAR(80)); CREATE TABLE appointments (id INT PRIMARY KEY, patient_id INT REFERENCES patients(id), doctor_id INT REFERENCES doctors(id), scheduled_for TIMESTAMP);

description: Academic system with courses, students, professors, and enrollments.
sql: CREATE TABLE students (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100)); CREATE TABLE courses (id INT PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(100), credits INT); CREATE TABLE enrollments (student_id INT, course_id INT, grade VARCHAR(2), PRIMARY KEY(student_id, course_id), FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES students(id), FOREIGN KEY(course_id) REFERENCES courses(id));
